x1.reason: The browser test's MIME fallback case is masked by Playwright filling audio/mp4; the fallback has no other test.
x1.fix: Drive the fallback with a file whose extension Playwright does not map.

x2.reason: The wrapped-error log test builds the chain by hand outside a handler, so it cannot catch traceback logging.
x2.fix: Raise a real chained exception inside an except block in the test.

x3.reason: make.sh can leave ok.webm overwritten with a stale hash if a later encode fails.
x3.fix: Encode into a temp dir and swap with the hash refresh at the end.

x4.reason: The permission-pending browser case can pass with the post-permission connection check removed.
x4.fix: Hold permission until after the redraw with a promise the test resolves.
